scope: Main281–292 through inline generation; exercises1–41, answers678–685

exceptions.detail: The full GraphBase word-pair census, dictionary membership/ranking and historical timings in main291–292 and exercise41 were not reproduced. The antipodal-pair reduction, masks with known corrections, and inline Gray traversal were checked.

The octacode weight enumerator19(a), the exact rational value in27, and the complete list of primitive characteristic polynomials/field orders in31 were retained without enumeration. Their constructions, the weight-enumerator substitution, the complete decoder case table20 and its worked example, the rank recursion27, and the characteristic-polynomial criterion31 were reviewed.

The no-16-square-composition conclusion and historical attributions in39 were accepted as standard/cited results. The displayed 8-by-8 matrix was checked against its signed-permutation formula; a full optimality search for the near-solution in39(b) was not performed. Historical ring-puzzle and transform-source attributions were not independently reconstructed.
